ModMetaData.name: Archinity - Altar
ModMetaData.author: cjd721
ModMetaData.description:
The blood-powered altar at the centre of the Archinity campaign, and the archite gene draw table it reads from.
This is the only mod in the Archinity suite that ships an assembly. Everything else is XML defs, which carry no simulation code and are inherently multiplayer-safe. Three things forced code here:
- Granting a NAMED gene. Nothing in vanilla represents a specific gene as an item; Genepack rolls its contents when it is created, so even a hand-placed genepack is random. - Charging a machine with a life rather than an item. A refuelable comp accepts anything matching its filter, which would let hemogen packs stand in for a sacrifice. - Rebinding VRE-Archon's equipment gate, which is a hardcoded check against one gene.
Pawn entry uses vanilla jobs throughout - EnterBuilding for a willing recipient, CarryToBuilding for an unwilling one - so the Multiplayer mod syncs it natively without needing its API.
Requires Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients for the archite genes, the linkable lab facilities and the altar's artwork.
